questions.question: A wise father urged his son to keep his commandments close. Where did he say to tie them and write them?

answers.text: On his fingers and his heart
On his doorposts and his gates
On a scroll and a stone tablet

questions.question: In a father's warning, when was the young man lacking judgment walking down the road to a dangerous woman's house?

answers.text: At twilight as the day faded to dark
At sunrise as the city woke up
At noon in the heat of the day

questions.question: In a father's warning, the woman who meets a young man tells him that her husband is at home. True or false?
At the end of a father's warning about a dangerous woman, where did he say her house leads?

answers.text: Down to the chambers of death
Out to a house of feasting
Up to the halls of honor
